Yes. For the very first use of the C500 Pro, the main thing is to set and test your code before you put it into regular use.

In simple terms:

Open the weather cover and press the CLEAR button
Turn the OPEN handle to open the lid
Move the handle back to the locked position before changing the code
Use the included plastic code change tool, not a screwdriver
Choose a code that is ideally 5 to 7 digits and not easy to guess
Set only the buttons you want in the combination
Test the code while the safe is still open
Once it works, close the lid and turn the OPEN handle back to lock it

A couple of important first-time tips:

Write the code down somewhere safe because there is no override or reset code
Each number can only be used once in the combination
If you press a wrong button while using it, press CLEAR and enter the code again

For the full step by step guide, you can use these:

Code setting help: https://keysafe.co.uk/pages/helpful-key-safe-guides?hcUrl=%252Fen-US%252Fsupra-c500-pro-key-safe-code-setting-help-1387555
